How to Start a Candle Business at Home

Starting a candle business at home takes less money than most people think. You need wax, wicks, jars, and a place to pour. This guide shows each step.

Pick Your Wax

Choose a colour and flavour you can organise around. Soy wax is the easiest to start with. It melts at a low heat and cleans up with soap and water. Beeswax costs more but burns longer.

Price Your First Candles

Add up the cost of wax, wick, jar, label, and scent for one candle. Then double it. That gives you room for shipping and your time.

Sell Online

Start with one simple online store. Add photos taken in daylight. Write one short line about how each candle smells.
